West Coast Floors
ESTIMATE TOTAL $12,400.00
Install 1,500 sq ft glue-down luxury vinyl plank with a 20 mil wear layer and 5 mm thickness. Remove existing carpet. Moisture testing and subfloor preparation included. Order 1,650 sq ft including 10% waste.

Metro Flooring
PROPOSAL TOTAL $8,900.00
Install 900 sq ft floating laminate. Owner is responsible for moving furniture and appliances. Baseboards are excluded. Transition strips included. Cleanup included.

Precision Surfaces
QUOTE TOTAL $7,450.00
Install engineered hardwood over prepared subfloor. Moisture barrier may be added if needed at additional cost. Acclimate material for 72 hours before installation.
